sentence_stem: Only after the final vote had been counted,
correct_completion: did the chairman finally announce the result.
full_sentence: Only after the final vote had been counted, did the chairman finally announce the result.
acceptable_variants: did the chairman at last announce the result.
did the committee finally publish the result.

options.text: the chairman finally announced the result.
options.why_wrong: After a fronted 'only after' phrase, the auxiliary verb must come before the subject, so the normal subject-verb order is incorrect here.

options.text: so the chairman announced the result.
options.why_wrong: 'So' introduces a result clause and does not complete the fronted structure; the sentence needs auxiliary inversion instead.

options.text: did the chairman finally announce the result.
the result was announced by the chairman.
options.why_wrong: The passive changes the focus but does not create the required inversion after a fronted 'only after' phrase.

grammar_focus: Subject-auxiliary inversion after fronted 'only after' phrases
explanation: After a fronted 'only after' phrase, the auxiliary verb must precede the subject. Spanish speakers often keep standard subject-verb order in this position, because English requires inversion after this structure.
translation: Solo después de contarse el voto final, el presidente anunció por fin el resultado.
